newsitem.title: USA: Centennial gets loan facilities proposal.
newsitem.headline: Centennial gets loan facilities proposal.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc on Thursday said it has received a proposal from Congress Financial, an asset-based lending institution, for replacement borrowing facilities.
Although no binding commitment has been received, Centennial said it expects to have such facilities in place by early July.
The company said its current financing arrangements with The First National Bank of Boston are due to expire on June 30, unless extended.
The company said it has reduced its revolving credit loan balance to about $5.4 million currently from about $13.5 million on February 11.
